name: SRY-box transcription factor 17

function.text: SOX17 encodes transcription factor SOX-17. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to pulmonary arterial hypertension (autosomal dominant); vesicoureteral reflux 3 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Endometrial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
